'''Connel''' is a [[Domani]] soldier under the command of [[Rodel Ituralde]].

== Activities ==
He acts as one of Ituralde's guards during the [[Battle of Maradon]]. He survives the initial attack and manages to limp inside the walls when the [[Saldaean]] relief comes.
He is again guarding Ituralde when a section of Maradon's wall is destroyed by enemy [[Dreadlord]]s. Connel manages to drag an injured Ituralde to the [[Healing]] tents.

==Trivia==
*Connel is named after Sean O'Connell, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
